📅 Slate Headlines + Flags

What is this? The top storylines for tonight's slate — where to stack, what to fade, and where the value is. Start here every day. Each card has a color-coded action tag and a link to the relevant board.

🔥 TOP PARK · STACK

Great American BP +11% HR — slate's top HR environment

KC @ CIN (7:10 ET). vs Chase Burns V45. Top bats here: Elly De La Cruz (81), Nathaniel Lowe (78), Spencer Steer (77), Sal Stewart (75). Park also +9% Runs.

→ See HR Board for these bats

STACK

CIN stack vs Luinder Avila (V74 — top target)

Great American BP +11% HR. HR Board: Elly De La Cruz #1 (Score 81, ⚡7), Nathaniel Lowe #2 (Score 78, ⚡6), Spencer Steer #3 (Score 77, ⚡5), Sal Stewart #4 (Score 75, ⚡7). Best same-game stack of the slate.

→ HR Board

STACK

LAA stack vs Kyle Freeland (V76)

Angel Stadium +4% HR. HR Board: Mike Trout #5 (Score 74), Zach Neto #6 (Score 72), Jorge Soler #8 (Score 69). Cross-game complement to the top stack.

→ HR Board
⚡
STRIKEOUT (K) TARGET

Strikeout leader: Joe Ryan 6.5 K — Best Line: O 5+

MIN vs CHW V21. Chase Burns 6.3 K (O 5+) is slate #2. Rule: ≥5 K → O5+, 4.5–4.99 → O3.5, <4.5 → O2.5. Never alt above 5 strikeouts.

→ Full K's Board
☢️
HR RISK · STACK OPPS

Pitcher's HR Risk Board: stack opponents on these arms

Kyle Freeland 1.04 HR/9 (vs LAA, V76), Chase Burns 0.91 HR/9 (vs KC, V45). All have HR-stack potential.

→ Pitcher's HR Risk Board
🥶
FADE HR ALTS

HR suppressed at 2 parks — fade HR alts

Target Field -19% HR (CHW @ MIN) / Nationals Park -17% HR (MIA @ WAS). Fade HR alts — pivot to 1+H / RBI / Runs plays.

→ Park Factors Board
⛔
SKIP K PROPS

1 arm below the strikeout floor — don't bet K props

Eduardo Rodriguez (ARI, K 3.3). All below the O 2.5 alt floor. Avoid strikeout props on these arms entirely.

→ Daily Skip List
